name: Woven
description: Centred on weaving diverse Indigenous knowledges and rights, the Woven Project strengthens collective strategies for self-determination and climate justice.
eventBlurb: Over five days in Gimuy (Cairns), fifty Indigenous leaders, knowledge holders, Elders, youth and climate champions from across the globe strengthen collective Indigenous-led climate justice strategies, promote the integration of traditional ecological knowledge into global climate solutions and policies, and foster a powerful, unified voice.
